blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in River Springs fell from 6 in June to 4 in October (−33.3%), and 5 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 1.1% of Coquitlam’s 378 houses listed.

blocks.text: River Springs home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

5 houses sold in River Springs with a median price of $1,205,000, taking a median of 17 days to sell at 98.5% of the last list price; 20% sold above list. They had a median $565 per square foot, a median year built of 1981 and a median lot of 4,506 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in River Springs?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 4 houses listed in River Springs. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is River Springs a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in River Springs had a sales ratio of 25% on only 4 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in River Springs from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 5 houses sold in River Springs over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in River Springs?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in River Springs sell for?
faq.a: 5 houses sold in River Springs between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,205,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in River Springs?
faq.a: The median was 17 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.5% of the last list price (20% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
